National Farmer's Day
JOIN US AS WE CELEBRATE
National Farmer's Day
at the LeRoy Coop - LeRoy Office
Monday, October 12th
Hot Dogs and Sides will be served from 11:00am to 1:30pm
National Farmer's Day on October 12th offers much deserved praise to the hard working farmers across the nation. In the midst of harvest season, the day pays tribute to the men, women, and families who put food in the grocery stores and on our tables every day.
Feedmill
Now that Kane Kellner has been our feedmill manager for a few months, we encourage you to give him a call and give the LeRoy Coop the opportunity to become your livestock feed headquarters! With our feed business continuing to grow, it is very important that feed orders be called in at least 3-5 business days in advance . This allows us to better plan our daily schedule, maximize feed production,and provide you with the best service possible.
We appreciate your business and would love the opportunity to serve your livestock feed needs. Give Kane Kellner a call today and let LeRoy Coop be your livestock feed headquarters!
Delayed payment fertilizer program
Once again, we are offering a delayed payment fertilizer program, which allows you to apply your spring fertilizer now, with payments due in December 2026 or January 2027. This program is for spring planted crops and does not apply toward wheat and cool season grass fertilizer. By applying fertilizer now, it will be an added plus of nutrient availability for your next spring crops
We have an excellent supply of fertilizer. Give us a call and we can apply it with our equipment and experienced operators. By having it custom applied, this allows you more time for other farming activities.
